audience: marketing and support staff who text customers with SimpleTexting

useCases.title: Review recent message history
useCases.text: The AI lists inbound and outbound messages and opens one to read its text, direction, status and time.

useCases.title: Check segments and cost of a text before sending
useCases.text: The AI does a dry run of a message body and shows the segment count, whether it goes as SMS or MMS, and the estimated cost. Nothing is sent.

useCases.title: Send a text message to a customer
useCases.text: The AI checks the text with a dry run, then sends an SMS or MMS to the phone number you give.

useCases.title: Look up or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by id or phone number and reads profile fields, list memberships and custom fields. It can change the fields you name.

useCases.title: Review sent campaigns and their recipients
useCases.text: The AI lists immediate campaigns by number, state, list or start date and opens one to read its message, recipients and status.

useCases.title: Find an MMS media item
useCases.text: The AI lists the account's MMS media items and opens one to read its URL and metadata.
